tei:div.tei:p: 475) mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: tshe 'phel yid bzhin 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzhugs: 476) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: gang zhig rnal 'byor ldan pa yis: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgya ru: bsgom zhing tshe bcud len pa'i thabs: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub pa bstan: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni:

na mo: rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma sgrol: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar 'god phyir: smon dang 'jug pa'i byang sems bskyed: lan gsum brjod mthar tshogs bsags ni: hoḥ rgyal yum 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul: sdom gsum bsrung mtshams 'gal 'das bshags: dus gsum dge la rjes yi rangs: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bla med byang chub myur thob shog: ces brjod de nas dngos gzhi ni: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa cheḥ stong nyid gdangs las snying rje'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yig tāṃ dkar gsal: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: snang ba dag pa stong chen mkha': srid pa 477)sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i zhing: bkod pa rab rdzogs gzhal yas dbus: chu skyes ge sar bzhad pa'i steng: zla ba'i gdan la rang rig tām̐: de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe ldan: zhal gcig spyan gsum bzhad pa'i zhal: phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchod sbyin dang: g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon rgyas: ut+pal steng na tshe bum 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: phyag zhabs mthil bzhir ye shes spyan: 'od 'bar zla ba'i rgyab yol mdzad: sku la longs spyod rgyan chas rdzogs: snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i skur: 'ja' tshon bzhin du wa ler bsgom: spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni: 'od snang mtha' yas tshe dpag med: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs tshe bum 'dzin: ye shes 'ja' 'od klong du gsal: thugs kar pad+ma zla rgyas steng: tām̐ yig dkar po'i mtha' bskor du: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las: 'od zer yar 478)'phros rgyal rnams mchod: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa bsdus:

mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad dang: 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud ma lus kun: 'od kyi rnam par tshur 'dus bstim: srog gi snying por ro gcig 'dres: snang ba lha la grags pa sngags: dran rtog chos nyid 'khor lo che: gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gsum ldan ngang: ma bcos rang byung bde ba che: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐: shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: mi tshig bdag gis bar ma bcad: 'bum phrag bdun gyis dngos grub thob: bar skabs tshe dmigs 'di ltar bya: thugs srog sa bon khong gseng du: g.yas su a dkar bla yi rten: g.yon du hūm̐ sngon tshe yi rten: dbus su nṛḥljang srog gi rten: rang mdog 'od thig klong du gsal: thugs srog tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros pas: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bsod dpal: ye shes yon tan ma lus pa: 'od zer dkar ljang mthing gsum gyi: rnam par bsdus te tshangs bug dang: shangs sgrom nas zhugs lus la thim: sa bon rnams dang dbyer med bsre: slar yang 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud rnams: lnga ldan 'od kyi rnam par bsdus: 479)sha khrag drod dbugs sems khams rnams: gso zhing ye shes lnga yi sgrom: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe rgyas thobs: dmigs gnad 'di ltar ldan pa'i ngang: bum can rlung gi gzhur drangs la: yid bzlas snying po 'di brjod bya: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bzlas phyi nang gzhan gsum kun: sngags kyi 'od dang sgra yis khyab: 'byin 'jug rlung gi gnad gcun na: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe thob nges: sa ma ya: e ma: de ltar tshe 'phel yid bzhin 'khor lo yi: sgrub thabs rgyun khyer gnad kyi gdams pa 'di: pho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi gces ba'i nor: zhi ba rdo rje mtsho nyid khyod la gtad: ma 'ongs las can gcig dang 'di 'phrad shog:

bka' yi gnyer 'dzin tshe ring ma la bcol: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang mkhas mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa bla ma tshe mchog rin po che'i zhal snga nas 'di ltar dgos zhes nan cher bka' gnang spyi bor phebs pa dang: grogs dam pa'i dus thabs rten 'brel gyi mthus gtad rgya cung zad sad pa la brten nas gang gi zhal ngo ma bzlog tsam du yig med mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las slob 'bangs tha shal ba 480)kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// ༈ thun mthar nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: 'phags pa'i thugs rje las sprul rje btsun ma: dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur tshe yi lha: dkar gsal mdangs ldan mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar: sgrub pa po la mchog gi dngos grub ster: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas: bde chen g.yu lo bkod du skye bar shog: ces pa'ang bde ba'i rdo rjes so// dge'o// ༈ 'chi ba bslu thabs ku sa li'i man ngag la/ bsrung bya pho mo gang yin gyi sku glud rgyan ldan zhig dang*/ bshal chu 'o chab/ chang bu/ sha dum/ ngar glud/ 'bru sna sogs gzhung bzhin dang*/ bdag bskyed cho ga sgrol dkar bsdus tsam mthar/ gzhan yang glud gtor byin brlabs dang 'gugs pa bya/ gzhung las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang saṃ bha ra bdun gyis chang bu sha dum ngar mi sogs bsngo zhing mtshan bzhi brjod mthar/ kyaiḥ 'khrul snang las kyi sogs/ dpal thob shog: yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang saṃ bha ra gong bzhin/ kyaiḥ'akhrul snang las kyi sogs/ de'i 'gres kyis 481)lan grangs ci rigs par bsngo zhing*/ spro na rdzongs 'debs/ gshegs gsol gzhan nas 'dzud/ min kyang bgegs bskrad byas te glud sbra khang mi mthong sar chung du bskyal nas srung gur bkra shis sogs bya'o//

gter ston nyid kyi zhal gsung bzhin tshul rdor pas bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ 'phrul yig las: rje btsun sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs dpag bsam snye ma bzhugs: e ma hoḥ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum: thugs rje byin rlabs gcig bsdus bcom ldan ma: 'phags ma nyer gcig zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal: bdag sogs 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: 'phags ma khyed kyis brtse bas rjes bzung ste: bdag mthong thos dang dran reg 'gro ba kun: rlabs chen byang chub sems mchog rgyud skyes nas: myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog: 'di la rtag tu brtson gyur na: 'phags mas rjes bzung the tshom med: sa ma ya: ces pa 'di yang dge btsun dam pa lha rje bsam gtan gyis 'di ltar dgos zhes nan cher bskul ngor mdo med bde ba'i rdo rjes ser dgon 482)dben phrod nas bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'phags ma'i gsol 'debs 'jigs pa kun skyob bzhugs: e ma hoḥ ka dag spros bral 'od gsal rig pa'i dbyings: lhun grub snang cha ma 'gags sgyu 'phrul gar: thugs rje rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma: rje btsun ār+ya tā re tshe sbyin dpal: gsol ba 'debs so rlung sems dbang bsdus nas: tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma a yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi bh+rūm̐ swā hāḥ khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: bdag gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang: 'jigs pa bcu drug rkyen ngan bar chad sol: 'gro la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po thul: bstan la 'tshe byed dam sri ma lus pa: ma khyod thugs rje nus mthu'i stobs rtsal gyis: ma lus zhi zhing bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: bstan 'dzin dam pa'i sku tshe bsring ba dang: dge 'dun sde tshogs 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs: ces pa 'di yang sprul sku rin po che'i bka' phebs ma bcag tsam du sprang mo skal bzang sgron ma'i ming gis bris nas phul ba'o//

dge'o// 475) mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: tshe 'phel yid bzhin 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzhugs: 476) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: gang zhig rnal 'byor ldan pa yis: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgya ru: bsgom zhing tshe bcud len pa'i thabs: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub pa bstan: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma sgrol: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar 'god phyir: smon dang 'jug pa'i byang sems bskyed: lan gsum brjod mthar tshogs bsags ni: hoḥ rgyal yum 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul: sdom gsum bsrung mtshams 'gal 'das bshags: dus gsum dge la rjes yi rangs: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bla med byang chub myur thob shog: ces brjod de nas dngos gzhi ni: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa cheḥ stong nyid gdangs las snying rje'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yig tāṃ dkar gsal: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: snang ba dag pa stong chen mkha': srid pa 477)sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i zhing: bkod pa rab rdzogs gzhal yas dbus: chu skyes ge sar bzhad pa'i steng: zla ba'i gdan la rang rig tām̐: de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe ldan: zhal gcig spyan gsum bzhad pa'i zhal: phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchod sbyin dang: g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon rgyas: ut+pal steng na tshe bum 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: phyag zhabs mthil bzhir ye shes spyan: 'od 'bar zla ba'i rgyab yol mdzad: sku la longs spyod rgyan chas rdzogs: snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i skur: 'ja' tshon bzhin du wa ler bsgom:

spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni: 'od snang mtha' yas tshe dpag med: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs tshe bum 'dzin: ye shes 'ja' 'od klong du gsal: thugs kar pad+ma zla rgyas steng: tām̐ yig dkar po'i mtha' bskor du: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las: 'od zer yar 478)'phros rgyal rnams mchod: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa bsdus: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad dang: 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud ma lus kun: 'od kyi rnam par tshur 'dus bstim: srog gi snying por ro gcig 'dres: snang ba lha la grags pa sngags: dran rtog chos nyid 'khor lo che: gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gsum ldan ngang: ma bcos rang byung bde ba che: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐: shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par: lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: mi tshig bdag gis bar ma bcad: 'bum phrag bdun gyis dngos grub thob: bar skabs tshe dmigs 'di ltar bya: thugs srog sa bon khong gseng du: g.yas su a dkar bla yi rten: g.yon du hūm̐ sngon tshe yi rten: dbus su nṛḥljang srog gi rten: rang mdog 'od thig klong du gsal: thugs srog tāṃḥlas 'od 'phros pas: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bsod dpal: ye shes yon tan ma lus pa: 'od zer dkar ljang mthing gsum gyi: rnam par bsdus te tshangs bug dang: shangs sgrom nas zhugs lus la thim: sa bon rnams dang dbyer med bsre: slar yang 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud rnams: lnga ldan 'od kyi rnam par bsdus: 479)sha khrag drod dbugs sems khams rnams: gso zhing ye shes lnga yi sgrom: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe rgyas thobs: dmigs gnad 'di ltar ldan pa'i ngang: bum can rlung gi gzhur drangs la: yid bzlas snying po 'di brjod bya: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bzlas phyi nang gzhan gsum kun:

sngags kyi 'od dang sgra yis khyab: 'byin 'jug rlung gi gnad gcun na: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshe thob nges: sa ma ya: e ma: de ltar tshe 'phel yid bzhin 'khor lo yi: sgrub thabs rgyun khyer gnad kyi gdams pa 'di: pho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi gces ba'i nor: zhi ba rdo rje mtsho nyid khyod la gtad: ma 'ongs las can gcig dang 'di 'phrad shog: bka' yi gnyer 'dzin tshe ring ma la bcol: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang mkhas mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa bla ma tshe mchog rin po che'i zhal snga nas 'di ltar dgos zhes nan cher bka' gnang spyi bor phebs pa dang: grogs dam pa'i dus thabs rten 'brel gyi mthus gtad rgya cung zad sad pa la brten nas gang gi zhal ngo ma bzlog tsam du yig med mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las slob 'bangs tha shal ba 480)kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// ༈ thun mthar nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: 'phags pa'i thugs rje las sprul rje btsun ma: dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur tshe yi lha: dkar gsal mdangs ldan mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar: sgrub pa po la mchog gi dngos grub ster: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas: bde chen g.yu lo bkod du skye bar shog: ces pa'ang bde ba'i rdo rjes so// dge'o// ༈ 'chi ba bslu thabs ku sa li'i man ngag la/ bsrung bya pho mo gang yin gyi sku glud rgyan ldan zhig dang*/ bshal chu 'o chab/ chang bu/ sha dum/ ngar glud/ 'bru sna sogs gzhung bzhin dang*/ bdag bskyed cho ga sgrol dkar bsdus tsam mthar/ gzhan yang glud gtor byin brlabs dang 'gugs pa bya/ gzhung las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang saṃ bha ra bdun gyis chang bu sha dum ngar mi sogs bsngo zhing mtshan bzhi brjod mthar/

kyaiḥ 'khrul snang las kyi sogs/ dpal thob shog: yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang saṃ bha ra gong bzhin/ kyaiḥ'akhrul snang las kyi sogs/ de'i 'gres kyis 481)lan grangs ci rigs par bsngo zhing*/ spro na rdzongs 'debs/ gshegs gsol gzhan nas 'dzud/ min kyang bgegs bskrad byas te glud sbra khang mi mthong sar chung du bskyal nas srung gur bkra shis sogs bya'o// gter ston nyid kyi zhal gsung bzhin tshul rdor pas bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ 'phrul yig las: rje btsun sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs dpag bsam snye ma bzhugs: e ma hoḥ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum: thugs rje byin rlabs gcig bsdus bcom ldan ma: 'phags ma nyer gcig zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal: bdag sogs 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: 'phags ma khyed kyis brtse bas rjes bzung ste: bdag mthong thos dang dran reg 'gro ba kun: rlabs chen byang chub sems mchog rgyud skyes nas: myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog: 'di la rtag tu brtson gyur na: 'phags mas rjes bzung the tshom med: sa ma ya: ces pa 'di yang dge btsun dam pa lha rje bsam gtan gyis 'di ltar dgos zhes nan cher bskul ngor mdo med bde ba'i rdo rjes ser dgon 482)dben phrod nas bris pa'o// dge'o// ༈ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'phags ma'i gsol 'debs 'jigs pa kun skyob bzhugs: e ma hoḥ ka dag spros bral 'od gsal rig pa'i dbyings: lhun grub snang cha ma 'gags sgyu 'phrul gar: thugs rje rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma: rje btsun ār+ya tā re tshe sbyin dpal: gsol ba 'debs so rlung sems dbang bsdus nas: tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma a yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi bh+rūm̐ swā hāḥ khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: bdag gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang: 'jigs pa bcu drug rkyen ngan bar chad sol:

'gro la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po thul: bstan la 'tshe byed dam sri ma lus pa: ma khyod thugs rje nus mthu'i stobs rtsal gyis: ma lus zhi zhing bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: bstan 'dzin dam pa'i sku tshe bsring ba dang: dge 'dun sde tshogs 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs: ces pa 'di yang sprul sku rin po che'i bka' phebs ma bcag tsam du sprang mo skal bzang sgron ma'i ming gis bris nas phul ba'o// dge'o//
